points.description: Meter table function: it holds per-flow meter entries / collects flow statistics (rate measurement) used to monitor flows and enable QoS-type operations such as rate-limiting, as used by the controller for network management. Equivalent wording accepted (e.g. measures and controls the rate of packets per flow). Must not describe the meter table as holding forwarding rules.

levels.says: Only says meters/stats per flow, or only mentions QoS/rate-limiting, without the other idea.

points.description: Flow pipeline function: it consists of flow tables containing rules/match fields and actions that determine how packets are processed and forwarded (implements forwarding/routing logic in the switch). Equivalent wording accepted.

levels.says: Says only that flow tables contain rules/entries, or only that they forward packets, without linking rules to actions/forwarding.

rubric.notes: Full marks need one correct function for the meter table (per-flow meters/statistics, QoS/rate-limiting) and one for the flow pipeline (rules/actions for packet forwarding). Give half of a point if only part of the idea is stated. Swapped or wrong roles earn nothing.
